Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organisation powered by 300\+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400\+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you **About the Role**
We are looking for a Fresher AI SEO Engineer who is curious about how people search using ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and other AI\-powered search platforms.  

Your main responsibility will be to help improve the visibility of our clients' websites, brands, products, and services in LLM and AI\-generated search results for targeted prompts and queries. This role sits at the intersection of SEO, AI, content, data, and experimentation. You do not need years of experience. We are looking for someone who is highly curious, analytical, comfortable experimenting with AI tools, and willing to continuously learn how AI search is evolving. **Responsibilities*** Optimize client websites and content to improve their visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, and other LLM\-powered search platforms.
* Conduct prompt research to understand what potential customers are asking AI platforms related to a client's products, services, industry, competitors, and buying decisions.
* Build and maintain a list of target prompts for each client and track how frequently the client's brand appears in AI\-generated answers.
* Research how different LLMs retrieve, understand, rank, cite, and recommend information.
* Understand how vector embeddings work to map out content retrieval.
* Understand the fundamentals of how LLMs, search engines, RAG systems, embeddings, knowledge graphs, citations, entities, and web content work together.
* Analyze why certain competitors or websites are being recommended by LLMs and identify opportunities for clients to improve their presence.
* Optimize website pages, content structure, internal linking, entities, FAQs, schema, topical coverage, and other signals that can improve visibility in AI search.
* Work with content teams to create and improve content that directly answers the questions users are asking AI platforms.
* Identify opportunities to get client brands mentioned, referenced, cited, and recommended across trusted websites and online sources.
* Understand the US market, especially how small and mid\-sized businesses operate, market themselves, generate leads, and make purchasing decisions.
* Study customer intent across different stages such as:
* Research
* Comparison
* Recommendation
* Problem solving
* Vendor selection
* Buying decisions
* Monitor how targeted prompts perform across different LLM platforms.
* Run experiments to understand what changes improve AI visibility and document the findings.
* Track traffic coming from AI platforms and identify opportunities to increase website traffic, leads, and conversions from LLM\-driven discovery.
* Measure the impact of AI SEO activities using metrics such as:
* Brand mentions in LLM results
* Citation frequency
* Share of AI search visibility
* Target prompt coverage
* Referral traffic from AI platforms
* Leads and conversions generated through AI discovery
* Stay continuously updated on changes happening across AI search, LLMs, SEO, GEO, AEO, and search technologies.

 **Qualifications**
We are open to candidates from different educational backgrounds. Candidates from the following areas may be a good fit:* Computer Science / IT
* Engineering
* Digital Marketing
* Marketing
* Business
* Data / Analytics


More than your degree, we care about your curiosity, problem\-solving ability, understanding of AI, and willingness to experiment and learn. **Required Skills*** Strong curiosity about AI, LLMs, SEO, and search technology.
* Basic understanding of SEO concepts such as keywords, search intent, content optimization, backlinks, technical SEO, and website structure.
* Good understanding of tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, or similar AI platforms.
* Ability to conduct detailed prompt and search intent research.
* Analytical mindset and willingness to test ideas instead of relying only on traditional SEO practices.
* Ability to understand patterns in LLM responses and competitor visibility.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Basic understanding of the US business market and small and mid\-sized businesses.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, data, analytics, and research tools.
* Ability to learn new AI tools and technologies quickly.

Success in this role means helping our clients become more visible when their potential customers ask AI platforms questions such as:* "What are the best companies for \[service]?"

title: SEO Executive
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Technical SEO Executive** to strengthen our digital marketing and organic search performance. The ideal candidate should have strong technical SEO expertise, a solid understanding of website architecture, and proven experience working in the **IT Services industry**.

The candidate will be responsible for improving organic visibility, identifying technical SEO opportunities, analyzing competitors, and collaborating with content and marketing teams to drive qualified traffic and business growth.

Key Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Digital Marketing**, or a related field.
* Minimum **3\- 5 years of hands\-on SEO experience**, preferably within the IT Services or technology sector.
* Strong understanding of **search engine algorithms, SEO guidelines, ranking factors, and industry best practices**.
* Working knowledge of **PPC, Social Media Marketing, and Email Marketing**.
* Strong expertise in both **on\-page and off\-page SEO**.
* Good technical understanding of **HTML, CSS, website architecture, and web technologies**.
* Experience with SEO and analytics platforms such as **Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools**.
* Strong analytical, research, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, content writers, designers, and marketing teams.
* Capable of working independently while handling multiple SEO initiatives and priorities.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform comprehensive **keyword research** to identify high\-value search terms and opportunities aligned with business objectives.
* Evaluate keyword difficulty, search intent, trends, and competitive landscapes to support SEO and content strategies.
* Optimize website pages, including **content, title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and other on\-page elements**.
* Develop and improve **internal linking strategies** to strengthen website authority, crawlability, and user navigation.
* Conduct regular **technical SEO audits** and identify issues affecting organic search performance.
* Diagnose and resolve technical problems such as **crawl errors, broken links, duplicate content, indexing issues, redirects, and website performance concerns**.
* Work with development teams to improve **website structure, page speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, and overall technical health**.
* Review and optimize website architecture to ensure that search engines can efficiently crawl, understand, and index important pages.
* Monitor organic search performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Analyze website data using **Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms** to measure traffic, rankings, conversions, and other key performance indicators.
* Conduct regular **competitor and industry analysis** to identify gaps, emerging trends, content opportunities, and potential threats.
* Establish SEO benchmarks and track performance against key industry competitors.
* Support **online reputation management**, including monitoring social profiles, brand mentions, and customer reviews.
* Coordinate with content teams to optimize existing content and promote new content across relevant external platforms.
* Stay informed about **search engine updates, SEO trends, emerging technologies, and changes in ranking algorithms**.
* Work closely with marketing and cross\-functional teams to align SEO activities with broader digital marketing goals.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Sales and Marketing Executive
description:
**Experience:** 2\+ Years

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Sales \& Marketing Executive** with 2\+ years of experience in ERP/Odoo sales. The candidate will be responsible for generating and qualifying leads, understanding client requirements, conducting Odoo ERP demonstrations, preparing proposals, and managing the complete sales cycle from initial contact to deal closure.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication, negotiation, client\-handling, and sales skills, along with a good understanding of **Odoo ERP and business processes**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate and qualify leads for **Odoo ERP solutions** through various channels.
* Identify potential clients and develop new business opportunities.
* Understand client business requirements and recommend suitable Odoo solutions.
* Handle client calls, meetings, discussions, and follow\-ups professionally.
* Conduct **Odoo ERP product demonstrations** based on client requirements.
* Prepare customized proposals, quotations, presentations, and commercial offers.
* Manage the complete sales cycle from **lead generation to deal closure**.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and convert qualified leads into customers.
* Handle client objections, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and close deals.
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with clients.
* Coordinate with functional and technical teams to ensure smooth project handover after sales closure.
* Maintain accurate lead and opportunity information in the CRM.
* Track sales activities, follow\-ups, pipeline status, and prepare regular sales reports.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to overall company revenue growth.
* Research market trends, competitors, and new business opportunities in the ERP market.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **2\+ years of experience in Sales/Business Development**, preferably in Odoo ERP, ERP, or software sales.
* Good understanding of **Odoo ERP modules and business processes**.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent presentation and product demonstration skills.
* Strong negotiation, convincing, and closing abilities.
* Experience in lead generation, client handling, and follow\-up.
* Ability to understand client requirements and provide appropriate solutions.
* Good knowledge of CRM and sales pipeline management.
* Target\-oriented, self\-motivated, and proactive approach.
* Ability to manage multiple leads and sales opportunities simultaneously.
* Good proficiency in English and professional communication.

**Preferred**

* Prior experience in **Odoo ERP sales or implementation sales**.
* Existing B2B client network or experience handling international clients.
* Experience with software/IT product sales.
* Knowledge of ERP solutions, business processes, and SaaS products.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Qualified leads generated
* Sales pipeline growth
* Number of product demos conducted
* Proposal\-to\-deal conversion rate
* Monthly/quarterly sales achievement
* New clients acquired
* Revenue generated
* Client retention and relationship management

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on **Odoo ERP and business automation solutions**.
* Growth and learning opportunities in ERP sales.
* Professional and collaborative work environment.
* Performance\-based career growth.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing \& Growth Specialist

**Company:** TestOwl  
**Location:** Ahmedabad / Remote  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About TestOwl

TestOwl is a no\-code test automation platform that helps engineering and QA teams automate regression testing without the overhead of writing and maintaining test scripts.

We’re looking for a **hands\-on Digital Marketing \& Growth Specialist** who can own TestOwl’s growth across **SEO, AEO, GEO, content, LinkedIn, backlinks, performance marketing, and demand generation.**

This is not a role where you simply manage agencies or post content. **You will own execution, experimentation, and measurable growth.**

**What You'll Own**

**1\. SEO \& Organic Growth**

* Own and execute TestOwl’s overall SEO strategy.
* Conduct keyword research and identify high\-intent keywords and content opportunities.
* Optimize website pages, landing pages, blogs, documentation, and product pages.
* Build topic clusters and topical authority around software testing, QA automation, test automation, and related topics.
* Handle technical SEO including indexing, crawlability, internal linking, schema, site structure, Core Web Vitals, etc.
* Monitor rankings, organic traffic, signups, demos, and conversions.
* Identify opportunities to increase qualified organic traffic and pipeline.

**2\. AEO \& GEO**

* Develop strategies to improve TestOwl’s visibility across AI\-powered search and answer engines.
* Optimize content for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other emerging discovery platforms.
* Identify questions and topics where TestOwl should appear as a trusted answer/source.
* Build content around search intent, entities, topical authority, FAQs, comparisons, and problem\-based queries.
* Track TestOwl’s visibility across traditional and AI search.

**3\. Performance Marketing \& Paid Acquisition**

* Own TestOwl’s paid acquisition strategy across relevant channels.
* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns on platforms such as:
* Google Ads
* LinkedIn Ads
* Meta Ads
* Retargeting/display platforms where relevant
* Develop campaigns targeting QA leaders, engineering leaders, CTOs, founders, and other relevant B2B SaaS audiences.
* Build and test different campaign types, audiences, creatives, messaging, landing pages, and offers.
* Manage campaign budgets and allocate spend based on performance.
* Track CAC, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, signup rates, demo bookings, and pipeline generated.
* Set up retargeting campaigns for website visitors and engaged audiences.
* Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels and campaigns.
* Work closely with the founder to identify and test new growth opportunities.
* Scale campaigns that demonstrate strong unit economics and quickly cut campaigns that don't perform.

**4\. Content Marketing**

* Develop a monthly content strategy based on business goals, search opportunities, customer pain points, and industry trends.
* Create and/or manage high\-quality blogs, landing pages, comparison pages, use cases, guides, and other content.
* Create content targeting QA leaders, engineering leaders, CTOs, founders, and software teams.
* Repurpose long\-form content into LinkedIn posts, carousels, videos, and other formats.
* Turn product insights, customer conversations, and industry trends into useful content.

**5\. LinkedIn \& Social Media**

* Own TestOwl’s LinkedIn content strategy.
* Create, schedule, and publish content consistently.
* Create:
* Text posts
* Single\-image posts
* Carousels
* Short videos
* Product\-led content
* Founder\-led content
* Educational content
* Industry commentary
* Experiment with hooks, formats, topics, and posting frequency.
* Track reach, engagement, profile visits, website traffic, signups, and leads generated.
* Support LinkedIn paid campaigns when required.

**6\. Backlinks \& Digital PR**

* Develop and execute a sustainable backlink acquisition strategy.
* Identify relevant websites, publications, blogs, directories, communities, and industry platforms.
* Conduct outreach for guest posts, partnerships, resource links, product listings, and other legitimate link\-building opportunities.
* Build relationships within QA, software testing, DevTools, engineering, and SaaS communities.
* Monitor backlink quality and identify opportunities to improve domain authority.
* Avoid spammy or black\-hat SEO practices.

**7\. Growth \& Conversion Optimization**

* Analyze the complete funnel from **impression → click → website visit → signup → demo → customer**.
* Identify drop\-offs and opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Run A/B tests on landing pages, CTAs, messaging, forms, and campaigns.
* Experiment with different acquisition channels, content formats, offers, and audiences.
* Continuously improve CAC, conversion rates, activation, and lead quality.

**8\. Analytics \& Reporting**

* Set up and monitor Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, ad platform analytics, and other relevant tools.
* Build clear reporting around:
* Organic traffic
* Paid traffic
* Keyword rankings
* Leads
* Signups
* Demo bookings
* CAC
* CPL
* ROAS
* Conversion rates
* Backlinks
* LinkedIn performance
* Use data to determine what is working and where to invest more resources.

**9\. Competitor \& Market Research**

* Monitor competitors’ SEO, content, paid advertising, backlinks, social media, and positioning.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities TestOwl can own.
* Research emerging trends in software testing, QA automation, AI\-generated software, developer tools, and SaaS.
* Identify new channels where potential customers are actively researching solutions.

What We're Looking For

You should be a **T\-shaped growth marketer** — broad enough to understand the complete digital marketing funnel and hands\-on enough to execute without depending on agencies.

**Must have:**

* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, SEO, or B2B SaaS marketing.
* Strong practical SEO knowledge.
* Experience running Google Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads.
* Experience with keyword research and content strategy.
* Experience creating content for LinkedIn.
* Experience with backlink building and outreach.
* Strong copywriting skills.
* Understanding of technical SEO.
* Experience with analytics and conversion tracking.
* Ability to analyze campaign and funnel data.
* Strong research and experimentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

**Good to have:**

* Experience marketing B2B SaaS or developer\-focused products.
* Experience in DevTools, QA, software testing, cybersecurity, or SaaS.
* Experience with AEO/GEO and AI search optimization.
* Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4, Google Tag Manager, etc.
* Basic design skills using Canva/Figma.
* Basic video editing skills.
* Experience with email marketing and marketing automation.
* Experience with Reddit, Product Hunt, Hacker News, Quora, and relevant online communities.

**Who Will Be a Great Fit?**

You will be a great fit if you:

* Are **hands\-on** and comfortable executing yourself.
* Can take an idea from research → content/campaign → distribution → measurement → optimization.
* Think beyond traffic and impressions and care about **leads, signups, CAC, and revenue**.
* Are comfortable managing both organic and paid channels.
* Enjoy experimenting and trying unconventional growth ideas.
* Can write compelling copy.
* Understand that SEO is more than publishing blogs.
* Are curious about how AI is changing search and content discovery.
* Can work independently in a fast\-moving startup environment.

**What This Role Is NOT**

This is **not** a role for someone whose primary experience is:

* Only managing social media.
* Only writing blogs.
* Only running paid ads without understanding organic growth.
* Managing agencies without hands\-on marketing experience.
* Generating large volumes of generic AI\-written content.
* Reporting vanity metrics without connecting them to business outcomes.

We need someone who can **own TestOwl’s entire digital growth engine.**

**Success in the First 90 Days**

Within the first 90 days, you should be able to:

* Build TestOwl’s SEO, content, AEO/GEO, and paid acquisition strategy.
* Identify our highest\-value keywords and growth opportunities.
* Improve important website and landing pages.
* Establish a consistent LinkedIn publishing engine.
* Publish high\-quality SEO content consistently.
* Start generating relevant backlinks.
* Launch and optimize initial Google/LinkedIn paid campaigns.
* Establish retargeting and conversion tracking.
* Build clear growth dashboards and reporting.
* Identify measurable improvements in qualified traffic, signups, demos, and pipeline.

**How to Apply**

Please send:

* Your resume.
* Examples of websites/companies you've worked on.
* SEO results you have achieved.
* Paid campaign results you have achieved, including budgets and key metrics where possible.
* Examples of LinkedIn/content work you've created.
* Examples of successful backlink/outreach campaigns.
* Tools you have hands\-on experience with.
* A brief answer to:

**“If you joined TestOwl tomorrow, what would you do in your first 30 days to increase organic visibility, generate qualified leads, and build a predictable acquisition engine?”**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and results\-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead Addact’s digital marketing initiatives and strengthen our online presence across global markets.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in B2B digital marketing, SEO, content marketing, social media, paid campaigns, lead generation, marketing analytics, and brand building. The person will work closely with the leadership, sales, business development, and technology teams to create marketing strategies that generate qualified opportunities and support business growth.

Key Performance Indicators / KPIs

Qualified leads / MQLs generated  
Marketing\-sourced pipeline  
Website organic traffic and conversions  
SEO rankings and organic visibility  
LinkedIn reach, engagement, and follower growth  
Content performance and lead generation  
Paid campaign CPL, CPA and conversion rate  
Landing\-page conversion rate  
Email campaign performance  
Webinar/event registrations and leads  
Marketing ROI

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.  
5–8 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in B2B IT services, SaaS, technology, consulting, or digital transformation.  
Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, content marketing, social media, paid advertising, email marketing, and lead generation.

Excellent content strategy and communication skills.  
Experience managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders.

Experience with international/B2B markets will be an advantage.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
**About FIAB**
Finance in a Box is an accounting and financial consulting firm based in California, providing outsourced CFO and controller services to companies around the world. FIAB operates as one managed operating partner for finance, HR, and regulatory readiness for growing businesses. FIAB recently expanded beyond finance into HR services through its partnership with GyroHR, and is preparing to launch FinOpz, an AI\-enabled finance operations platform, as a new product line alongside its core services business.  

  

**The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager / Marketing Lead to build and run marketing for Finance in a Box, as a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role working closely with FIAB's fractional CMO. You'll personally plan, write, run, and measure campaigns, own the marketing side of our CRM (HubSpot), lead nurture campaigns, build our LinkedIn and thought\-leadership presence, and work side\-by\-side with BD/Sales to turn marketing activity into a measurable pipeline.
You'll also take on product marketing support for FinOpz, our new AI\-enabled finance operations platform, as one part of a broader, all\-around marketing role rather than a dedicated product marketing seat. You'll meet weekly with the fractional CMO to set priorities and review work, and use freelancers or agencies as extra hands, not as a substitute for your own execution.  

  

**Responsibilities**
Campaigns \& demand generation* Own multi\-channel campaign execution (LinkedIn, email, content, webinars/events) that generates qualified leads for priority segments.
* Manage the marketing side of our CRM (HubSpot): email nurture campaigns, list segmentation, and reporting, in coordination with BD/Sales on lead handoff and pipeline feedback.
* Partner with BD/Sales on account\-based approaches for target accounts and joint go\-to\-market plans.
* Track leads through the funnel and report results and ROI to leadership.


Brand \& content* Build and personally drive our LinkedIn presence and thought\-leadership content: founder posts, articles, case studies, and market commentary that build credibility across finance and HR/people\-ops circles.
* Translate FIAB's finance, HR, and expanding service offerings into clear, differentiated positioning and messaging for different buyer personas.
* Own website updates, one\-pagers, decks, and sales\-enablement content, working with leadership and BD.
* Track competitor positioning and market developments in fintech/finops, and B2B services to keep messaging sharp and current.


Product marketing (FinOpz)* Take on product marketing support for FinOpz as it moves through beta and toward public launch, coordinating with the fractional CMO on strategy and priorities.


Process \& vendor management* Build repeatable marketing processes, calendars, SOPs, and playbooks, proactively identifying and fixing gaps rather than running campaigns ad hoc.
* Brief and manage external agencies, freelancers, or contract designers/copywriters, holding them accountable for quality and deadlines while retaining ownership of strategy and outcomes.
* Meet weekly with the fractional CMO to set priorities, review work, and course\-correct.

  

**What You'll Need*** 10\-12\+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong track record in demand generation, not just brand or communications.
* Genuinely fluent with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as a core part of how you work, not an occasional add\-on. You'll be a team of one and need to multiply your own output.
* Hands\-on experience running the marketing side of a CRM/marketing automation platform (HubSpot strongly preferred): nurture tracks, list management, and reporting.
* Proven experience building LinkedIn presence and thought\-leadership content for a B2B brand or leader.
* Experience working closely with BD/Sales on pipeline generation, lead handoff, and account\-based approaches.
* Comfortable marketing technology, recruitment/HR, or financial and professional\-services offerings to sophisticated B2B buyers.
* A bias for personal execution: comfortable writing copy, building campaigns, and getting into the details rather than only directing others.
* Data\-driven mindset: able to set up and read funnel metrics and adjust tactics based on results.
* Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, or contractors to deliver on brief and on time.
* Strong written communication skills in English, with real editorial judgment on what AI\-assisted drafts still need before they're ready to ship.
* A self\-starter who takes a loose direction and turns it into a concrete plan, and builds process and structure proactively.

  

**Nice to Have*** Experience marketing a new product launch, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech.
* Experience as the first or sole marketing hire in a growing services or technology business.
* Familiarity with account\-based marketing motions alongside demand generation.
* Comfort with design/no\-code tools (Canva, basic Figma, website CMS) to move quickly without always relying on a designer.
* Exposure to both US and India B2B buyer contexts.
* Experience working alongside a fractional or outside CMO/marketing advisor.

title: Manager - Manufacturing, Operations & Supply Chain
description:
**Role Objective**

To drive Brillare's supply planning and logistics operations, ensuring the right products are available at the right place and time to support the company's rapid growth across channels and geographies.

The role will have a strong focus on demand and supply planning, inventory management, warehousing, logistics, and delivery performance, while working closely with Production and Purchase teams to ensure seamless availability of finished goods.

The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on supply chain professional who can build robust planning processes, improve forecast accuracy, optimize inventory, and ensure high service levels without excessive working capital or stock\-outs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Demand \& Supply Planning**

● Own the demand and supply planning process across SKUs, channels, and geographies.

● Translate sales forecasts, marketing campaigns, new product launches, and channel expansion plans into actionable production and procurement requirements.

● Build and strengthen the S\&OP process in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Production, and Purchase teams.

● Improve forecast accuracy and ensure optimal inventory availability across the network.

● Minimize stock\-outs, excess inventory, obsolescence, and working capital lock\-up.

**2\. Logistics, Warehousing \& Delivery Excellence**

● Own the movement of finished goods from manufacturing locations to warehouses, distributors, retail partners, and customers.

● Drive strong logistics and delivery performance across GT, MT, e\-commerce, quick commerce, EBOs, and other relevant channels.

● Ensure high levels of **OTIF (On\-Time In\-Full)** and service\-level excellence.

● Monitor and improve order fulfilment, dispatch planning, delivery timelines, freight costs, and logistics partner performance.

● Identify bottlenecks across warehousing and distribution and implement scalable solutions.

**3\. Inventory \& Working Capital Management**

● Maintain optimal inventory levels across raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods.

● Establish inventory norms and monitor ageing, slow\-moving, and obsolete inventory.

● Balance product availability with working capital efficiency.

● Build dashboards and MIS to provide visibility on stock availability, inventory health, forecast accuracy, and service levels.

**4\. Production Planning Coordination**

● Work closely with manufacturing teams to align production schedules with demand forecasts and inventory requirements.

● Understand production capacities, lead times, constraints, and batch economics to create realistic supply plans.

● Ensure adequate capacity planning for business growth, seasonal peaks, promotions, and new product launches.

● Proactively identify potential supply constraints and develop mitigation plans.

**5\. Purchase \& Procurement Coordination**

● Work closely with the Purchase team to ensure timely availability of raw materials and packaging materials.

● Understand procurement lead times, vendor dependencies, and material availability risks.

● Support supplier planning and ensure procurement schedules are aligned with production requirements.

● Help identify opportunities to improve material availability and reduce supply disruptions.

**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

● Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Production, Purchase, Finance, Quality, and R\&D teams.

● Support new product launches by ensuring material, production, inventory, and logistics readiness.

● Drive process improvements across planning, inventory, warehousing, and logistics.

● Build scalable systems and processes capable of supporting rapid business growth.

**Ideal Candidate ProfileExperience \& Background**

● 6–10 years in manufacturing, operations, or supply chain in:

○ FMCG

○ Personal Care

○ Beauty / Pharma / Consumer products

**● Strong experience in:**

○ Demand planning

○ Warehousing, logistics \& Delivery

● Exposure to new product launches is a strong plus

**Skills \& Attributes**

● Systems\-builder — can scale operations, not just run them

● Highly analytical, structured, and data\-driven

● Strong ownership mindset — treats factory, inventory \& cost as their own P\&L

● Comfortable in fast\-changing, high\-growth environments

● Calm, mature, and execution\-focused

**Educational \& Professional Credentials**

● IIT / NIT / Tier\-1 Engineering College preferred

● MBA / Operations specialisation is a plus

● Strong pedigree in MNC FMCG / high\-quality manufacturing setups

title: Clinical Application Specialist (Guj, MP & CH)
description:
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next\-generation, life\-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

  

The **Clinical Sales** role is responsible for driving Leica Biosystems’ Core Histopathology, Immunohistochemistry (IHC), and Digital Pathology growth through a strong combination of clinical application expertise and direct sales execution. The role will support customers across the assigned territory through technical consultation, product demonstrations, proof\-of\-principle activities, customer training, troubleshooting, and scientific engagement, while also carrying sales targets and contributing directly to opportunity creation, funnel progression, revenue conversion, and market share expansion.

  

This position reports to the **Regional Manager, West** and is part of the Sales/Commercial organization located in **Ahmedabad, India** and will be fully remote to cover the Westregion.

 **In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Provide clinical application expertise across Core Histopathology, IHC, Digital Pathology, IVD, and RUO portfolios through customer training, troubleshooting, technical consultation, workflow optimization, and scientific discussions with pathologists, laboratory professionals, researchers, and key opinion leaders.
* Drive pre\-sales and post\-sales customer engagement by planning and executing product demonstrations, workshops, scientific meetings, academic programs, exhibitions, customer education initiatives, and Proof of Principle activities including evaluations, sampling programs, and customer validations.
* Carry and deliver assigned sales targets by identifying, creating, qualifying, and converting opportunities through direct customer engagement, while supporting business objectives, revenue growth, market share expansion, and customer adoption.
* Build and maintain a robust sales funnel, ensure accurate CRM opportunity tracking, prepare monthly activity reports, and document customer interactions, application support activities, follow\-up actions, and business outcomes.
* Collaborate closely with sales, marketing, channel partners, regional and global application teams, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues, gather market and competitive intelligence, strengthen customer relationships, and support strategic business decisions.

 **The essential requirements of the job include****:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pathology, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in Histopathology, Immunohistochemistry, Pathology Applications, Clinical Diagnostics, Diagnostic Sales, or Technical Sales.
* Demonstrated knowledge of pathology workflows, antibody\-based assays, immunohistochemistry, companion diagnostic applications, and related cancer diagnostics workflows.
* Proficiency in customer\-facing application support, product demonstrations, technical troubleshooting, customer training, opportunity tracking, Microsoft Office applications, and CRM tools.
* Ability to travel 60–80% within the assigned territory and other geographies as business needs require.

 **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Experience working with pathology laboratories, cancer diagnostics, immunohistochemistry reagents, companion diagnostics, or primary antibodies.
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing application specialist, product specialist, clinical sales specialist, technical sales, or diagnostic sales role.
* Exposure to distributor/channel partner management, territory development, market intelligence, and competitive analysis.
